newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai's Pudong 1996 exports up 13 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai's Pudong 1996 exports up 13 pct in 1996.

text.p: Exports from Shanghai's premier development zone, Pudong New Area, grew 13 percent in 1996 to $2.8 billion from 1995, accounting for 20 percent of the city's total exports last year, Business News said on Wednesday.
Exports from foreign-funded firms in the zone grew 55 percent in 1996, to $480 million, and accounted for 12 percent of Shanghai's total exports, the newspaper said.
The figures are all for international exports.
